name: Inu/Extra+
source:
A [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dead_or_Alive_%28series%29]Dead or Alive[/url] doujin, wherein Leifang was captured by the organization.

She bravely handled herself under the difficult situation. However Leifang began to fade tragically as she was being drugged...with a secret drug.

The noble spirited female warrior turned into a mere female dog after repeated assaults.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE042390.html]DLsite English[/url]]
